title: PHILGEPS + UNGM OPPORTUNITY BRIEFING

executive_summary.source_access_notes: PhilGEPS official public category pages were checked live for all six scoped categories; the first visible page in each category (105 listings total) was reviewed and shortlisted notices were opened directly. UNGM official public search returned 18 unique active notices; several detail requests were rate-limited with HTTP 429, but listing fields and successfully opened public notices were still reviewed. No login-gated or restricted source was used.

best_opportunities.project: Procurement of Social Media Marketing Services for Clark Aviation Capital
best_opportunities.procurement_method: Negotiated Procurement - Small Value Procurement (Sec. 34); RFQ 26-09-003
best_opportunities.why_fit: Direct fit for Brandee AI and AIStaff's digital-content services: monthly content planning, static posts, short-form video, publishing, boosting reports, analytics, SEO recommendations, and source-file turnover over six months.
best_opportunities.what_they_need: A six-month social-media marketing engagement delivering a monthly content calendar, four static posts and two short-form videos per month, scheduled publishing, boosting-performance and analytics reports, SEO recommendations, and next-month action plans.
important_requirements: Official notice is Active and lists a six-month delivery period.
Submit PhilGEPS Certificate, current Business/Mayor's Permit, BIR Form 2303, ITR, and Omnibus Sworn Statement.
The notice references an attached detailed scope of work and scoring sheet, but no public attachment was available through the abstract page.
Official contact: Wilbern Dayrit Ramos, Procurement Officer III, +63 0 599 2888 ext. 711, wilbernramos@ciac.gov.ph.
The public abstract does not state a prior-project threshold or a specific PhilGEPS membership color/level.
risks_or_blockers: The scoring sheet and detailed scope must be reviewed before pricing; boosting/media spend inclusion is not explicit in the abstract.
The posted ABC is VAT zero-rated, so finance should confirm the correct commercial treatment.
Portfolio and content-quality scoring may materially affect competitiveness.
how_we_could_qualify: AIStaff directly through Brandee AI plus human creative oversight.
Use existing short-form video, campaign-planning, analytics, and social-content portfolio samples.
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Obtain the detailed scope and scoring sheet today; confirm whether paid boosting budget is inside the ABC, required platforms, approval turnaround, production locations, and ownership/licensing of source assets.

best_opportunities.project: Human Resource Integrated System (HRIS) Software Development & Implementation for LGU Badian
best_opportunities.procurement_method: Public Bidding / Invitation to Bid; Solicitation OM-605-O-2026
best_opportunities.why_fit: A custom HR information system is a direct fit for AIStaff's software-development, workflow automation, dashboards, records, notifications, and systems-integration capability.
best_opportunities.what_they_need: Development and implementation of an HRIS for municipal HR operations; the public abstract does not expose functional modules or technical specifications.
important_requirements: Official notice is Active, classified as Goods, with a 45-day delivery period.
Pre-bid conference: September 18, 2026 at 2:00 PM, BAC Office, Badian Municipal Hall.
Official contact: Maria Joebelle Balbona Malagueno, BAC Secretariat Head, +63 956 784 3596, badianbacsec@gmail.com.
The public abstract does not state the PhilGEPS membership level, detailed eligibility documents, prior-experience threshold, submission method, or complete HRIS specifications.
risks_or_blockers: Full public bidding creates a heavier compliance burden than an RFQ.
A 45-day delivery period may be aggressive depending on payroll, biometric, leave, records, and migration scope.
Viability cannot be confirmed until the bid documents disclose SLCC, staffing, data migration, security, and integration requirements.
how_we_could_qualify: AIStaff directly if the bid documents accept relevant custom-platform experience and the 45-day scope is bounded.
Partner for payroll-domain or biometric integration expertise if those modules are mandatory.
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Attend or obtain records from the pre-bid conference and request the bid documents, module list, SLCC threshold, deployment model, data migration volume, integrations, warranty, and acceptance criteria.

best_opportunities.project: Supply and Delivery of Computer Software for Barangay Inhabitant Registration and Transaction System (BIRTS)
best_opportunities.deadline: September 28, 2026 9:00 AM (PHT) per description; header shows 8:00 AM
best_opportunities.procurement_method: Public Bidding / Invitation to Bid; PB 2026-41
best_opportunities.why_fit: Citizen registration and transaction software aligns with AIStaff's custom databases, online forms, dashboards, service workflows, and integrations.
best_opportunities.what_they_need: A Barangay Inhabitant Registration and Transaction System delivered within 90 calendar days.
important_requirements: Bidder must have completed a similar contract within three years before bid submission.
Bidding documents cost PHP 5,000; manual submission and bid security are required.
Pre-bid conference: September 16, 2026 at 9:00 AM at the BAC Office, Santa Barbara Municipal Hall.
Bidding is restricted under the posted Filipino ownership/reciprocity rule.
Official contact: Atty. Cynthia C. Natividad, Head BAC Secretariat, +63 931 023 3036 / +63 75 649 2523 ext. 113, sbpbidsandawardscommittee@gmail.com.
The public abstract does not identify the required PhilGEPS membership level or detailed technical specifications.
risks_or_blockers: The prior similar-contract requirement may exclude a new supplier unless AIStaff has a qualifying completed project or an allowed partner structure.
The notice header says closing is 8:00 AM, while the description says submission and opening are 9:00 AM; treat 8:00 AM as the safe deadline until BAC clarifies.
Public bidding, manual submission, bid security, and paid documents increase burden.
how_we_could_qualify: Use a completed citizen-records, CRM, registration, or transaction-platform contract if the BAC confirms it is similar.
Consider an eligible joint venture or prime partner only if the bidding documents permit it.
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Ask the BAC to reconcile the 8:00/9:00 AM deadline conflict and confirm what counts as a similar contract, the SLCC amount, PhilGEPS level, required modules, hosting, migration, privacy controls, and whether a joint venture is allowed.

best_opportunities.procurement_method: Negotiated Procurement - Small Value Procurement (Sec. 34); RFQ 2026-LGU-082
best_opportunities.why_fit: A digital archiving system may fit AIStaff's document workflows, search, access control, dashboards, and custom-system work, and the SVP route is relatively accessible.
best_opportunities.what_they_need: An archiving system delivered within 10 days; the public notice says only to see the attached purchase request, which was not publicly accessible from the abstract.
important_requirements: Official notice is Active and uses Small Value Procurement.
Official contact: Esmeralda V. Medina, Municipal Civil Registrar, +63 75 549 2318, patriciaazurin01@gmail.com.
The public abstract does not state technical requirements, eligibility documents, prior experience, submission method, or PhilGEPS membership level.
risks_or_blockers: Only three days remain and the 10-day delivery period is tight.
The system may include scanning hardware or records-digitization labor outside AIStaff's preferred software scope.
No decision should be made without the purchase request and submission checklist.
how_we_could_qualify: AIStaff directly if the scope is software-only and accepts a configurable document-management solution.
Use a scanning/digitization partner only if physical conversion is required and subcontracting is allowed.
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Request the purchase request immediately and confirm whether hardware, bulk scanning, on-site work, existing-record migration, user count, hosting, and Red PhilGEPS registration are required.

not_recommended.project: Data Governance Consultancy and IT Systems Programming Support Services
not_recommended.reason: Excellent technical fit and SVP route, but the TOR requires 3-5 years of firm experience, a completed similar Philippine government project, a five-person senior team, production-system reverse engineering, security work, two-person standby coverage, rapid incident response, and six months of warranty. Those explicit eligibility and delivery demands make this unrealistic for AIStaff as a new supplier without a qualified prime partner.

not_recommended.project: Subscription of Cloud-Based Quarry and Logistics Monitoring System (SaaS)
not_recommended.reason: Software theme fits, but the PHP 7.48M public bid requires a completed similar contract, bid security, manual submission, an PHP 8,000 bid-document fee, and a stated seven-calendar-day delivery requirement that conflicts with the header's zero-day field. This appears suited to an established quarry/logistics platform vendor.

Strong chatbot fit and remote delivery, but the notice is Spanish-language, Mexico-specific, closes in two days, and requires a structured technical/financial submission through UNDP Quantum. Keep as an urgent awareness item, not a recommended pursuit.

not_recommended.project: Provision of CRM Solution support and maintenance services for Salesforce application
not_recommended.reason: The EOI requires recognized Salesforce expertise and Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud consultant certification. AIStaff's general CRM/integration capability does not satisfy that explicit vendor qualification.

not_recommended.project: SaaS platform for technical-scientific-educational content production
not_recommended.reason: New Basic-registration SaaS notice, but it is Portuguese-language, Brazil-focused, and seeks a specialized existing content-production platform for multi-country health cooperation. This is not a practical first-entry pursuit for AIStaff.

The listing header shows a September 14 deadline, but the description says bids were due August 24 and clarification questions August 12. This unresolved internal inconsistency, plus enterprise loan-system complexity and In-Tend submission, makes it unsuitable.

todays_recommendation.best_opportunity: Pursue initial qualification for Clark Aviation Capital's Social Media Marketing Services (PhilGEPS Ref 13230289). It is the clearest service match, uses Small Value Procurement, has a six-day preparation window, and asks for standard supplier documents rather than an explicit multi-year government systems track record.

clarifications_to_request: Clark: obtain the detailed scope and scoring sheet; confirm platforms, paid-media budget treatment, on-site production, approval workflow, KPIs, and source-file licensing
Badian HRIS: request module specifications, SLCC/prior-experience rules, integrations, migration, security, hosting, warranty, and 45-day acceptance milestones

Confirm AIStaff's current PhilGEPS membership level and whether it satisfies each notice before committing bid preparation

notes: PhilGEPS official public category pages showed 323 Information Technology, 71 Consulting Services, 25 Communication Equipment and Parts, 154 Services, 295 Office Equipment, and 5 Advertising Agency Services opportunities. This run reviewed the first visible page of each category, totaling 105 listings, and then opened each shortlisted notice.

The Clark, Badian, Santa Barbara, Aguilar, NWRB, Pangasinan SaaS, and SK San Antonio notices were checked on official PhilGEPS abstract pages. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, paid document download, or restricted attachment access was attempted.

UNGM was checked using its official public active-notice search and public notice pages. The scan reviewed 18 unique active listings; some detail pages returned HTTP 429 after public-search activity, so those entries were evaluated only from the official listing fields unless their detail page loaded successfully.

Public notice detail was successfully checked for UNGM 313371, 312623, 312399, 309505, 312637, and 309763. UNGM 312323, 312332, 312249, 312881, 311938, 310644, 312901, 311934, 312478, 310864, 312141, and 311347 encountered detail-page rate limiting during this run.

The Santa Barbara BIRTS notice contains a deadline inconsistency: header 8:00 AM versus description 9:00 AM on September 28. The Pangasinan quarry SaaS notice contains a duration inconsistency: header 0 days versus description 7 calendar days. The UNRWA loan-system listing contains a September 14 header deadline but August dates in the description. None was resolved by assumption.

No public attachment was downloaded or substantively relied on. The NWRB TOR was embedded in the public abstract; other notices referenced attachments or bid documents that were not accessible directly from the abstract.
No bids were submitted, no procurement or clarification emails were sent, no accounts were registered, and no commitments were made.
